ambiguousAlternatives.reason: Infected pancreatic necrosis can cause systemic inflammation in pancreatitis, but the stem provides no necrosis imaging or other evidence of infected necrosis and instead identifies persistent distal CBD obstruction.

missingInformation: Trends in BP/MAP, urine output, lactate, bilirubin, oxygen requirement, and mental status; blood-culture results; liver-enzyme pattern; renal function; medication allergies; and imaging evidence for pancreatic necrosis are not provided.
reasoning: The combination of gallstone pancreatitis, fever, leukocytosis, hyperbilirubinemia, and imaging-confirmed distal CBD obstruction best supports evolving cholangitis.
